SET_ID

,SET_DESC

,RCRE_USER_ID

,ALT1_SET_DESC

,SCD_END_DATE
,ISACTIVE
,ISLATEST
,BNK_CODE
,SOURCE_CODE
,FILE_NAME
,insert_dttm
